scenes.title: The Crumb Line
scenes.storyBeat: Small sugar-rushed slimes need plates, not punishment.
storyboardPanels: Cupcake Slimes crowd the crumb trail.
Bruk studies crumbs like a battlefield map.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Hold position. This is no ordinary crumb trail.
Sugar-rushed slimes have insufficient napkin protocol.
They are not raiders. They are hungry, frightened, and poorly queued.

choices.label: Raise the Crumb Shield
choices.narration: Bruk plants his shield and slows the sugar-rushed charge.

choices.label: Serve the Smallest Plate
choices.playerLine: Small portions. Fair turns. No pushing.
choices.narration: Bruk uses his shield as a serving tray. The slimes stop surging and discover manners.

choices.label: Charge the Frosting Line
choices.playerLine: By crumb and crust, we charge before the frosting hardens.

npcResponse.text: Heroic snack momentum may exceed frosting traction.

choices.narration: Bruk scatters sprinkles and opens the path, but the board inherits slippery enthusiasm.

victoryCallback.text: The cart stands. The slimes are seated. Victory with napkins.

bossCallback.text: Fair portions, Your Wobbliness. Seconds after the battle.

scenes.title: The Lunch Belt
scenes.storyBeat: Hungry goblin testers keep breaking machines because no one feeds the shift.
storyboardPanels: Warning placards blink SAFE AFTER LUNCH.
Goblins argue near a junk press.
Unopened lunch tins sit behind a guard rail.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Workshop running on zero percent sandwiches.

choices.label: Barricade the Lunch Belt
choices.playerLine: The junk press will not dine on crumbs while I stand here.

npcResponse.text: Heavy-handed, attached to a knight, so that tracks.

choices.narration: Bruk wedges his shield across the belt and slows the junk press.

choices.label: Feed the Tired Testers
choices.playerLine: Three bites each. Then we fix the machine with wiser hands.
choices.narration: The goblins eat, blink, and finally point out the lever nobody should pull during snack hour.

choices.label: Ram the Gear Buffet

npcResponse.text: Mobile buffet tactics are outside warranty.

choices.narration: A snack cart rolls through the workshop like a banquet battering ram.

postChoiceBarks.text: Eat first. Explode later, preferably never.

victoryCallback.text: The machines are quieter. The goblins are chewing.

bossCallback.text: A fed worker makes wiser mistakes.

scenes.title: The Warm Ration
scenes.storyBeat: Warm rations save more crates than a shield wall alone.
storyboardPanels: Ration crates are sealed in ice.
Bruk warms a thermos between gauntlets.

preChoiceDialogue.text: A ration locked away is no ration at all.
Careful. That shelf is holding more flavors than it should.
Then we warm the courage before we move the crates.

choices.label: Stack the Ration Crates
choices.playerLine: Supplies rescued at the cost of supplies are not rescued.
choices.narration: Bruk braces the shelf with a small fortress of provisions.

choices.label: Share the Warm Thermos
choices.playerLine: Before the crates, the guards. A warm drink steadies watchful hands.
choices.narration: Bruk shares the thermos, and the sprites show which crates can thaw safely.

choices.label: Shoulder the Ice Door
choices.playerLine: Stand behind my shield. This door has mistaken itself for a wall.
choices.narration: Bruk shoulders the door open and showers the hall with useful frost and risky ice.

victoryCallback.text: Crates saved. Guards warmed. The pantry holds.

bossCallback.text: Safe from spoiling, yes. Not safe from being forgotten.

scenes.title: The Nap Table Oath
scenes.storyBeat: The Pillow Castle has a sacred nap table.
storyboardPanels: A tiny table holds milk and biscuits.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Sacred nap table. No loud forks.
A table with rest upon it is a table under oath.
We pass with biscuits and respect.

choices.label: Hold the Blanket Line
choices.playerLine: No blanket will tangle the table while I stand.
choices.narration: Bruk holds the blanket line and stabilizes sleepy pressure.

choices.label: Honor the Nap Table
choices.playerLine: No snack left behind. No nap dishonored.
choices.narration: Bruk sets biscuits in fair portions and the castle lets him pass between snores.

choices.label: Trumpet the Midnight Feast
choices.playerLine: If supper must come, let it arrive with honor and a very soft horn.

npcResponse.text: Midnight feast declared at pillow-safe volume.

choices.narration: A gentle trumpet wakes appetites without waking the whole castle. Mostly.

postChoiceBarks.text: A nap table is still a table. Guard it well.

victoryCallback.text: The table rests. So does my oath.

bossCallback.text: One who respects the sacred nap requests passage between snores.

scenes.title: The Winning Tickets
scenes.storyBeat: Winning tickets matter less than splitting the prize table honestly.
storyboardPanels: Tickets pile higher than a child.

preChoiceDialogue.text: ONLY THE HIGHEST SCORE SHALL FEAST!
I have come to feed them better manners.

choices.label: Guard the Prize Counter
choices.playerLine: First, no one tramples the snacks.
choices.narration: Bruk holds the prize counter and calms the ticket rush.

choices.label: Split the Winning Tickets
choices.playerLine: Victory is sweeter when the second plate also moves.
choices.narration: Bruk splits the tickets into prize hampers for winners and watchers alike.

choices.label: Win the Snack Jackpot
choices.playerLine: For the table. For the guests. For the extremely visible hamper.
choices.narration: Bruk wins a tower of snacks, then must keep the prize surge from becoming a stampede.

postChoiceBarks.text: Count the guests. Then count the tickets.

victoryCallback.text: The prize table is lighter and the crowd is fairer.

bossCallback.text: The highest score may shine. The table still serves everyone.

scenes.title: A Chair for the King
scenes.storyBeat: Victory is setting Bloxley a place at the table.
storyboardPanels: A banquet gate locks away round cakes.
A throne sits higher than every chair.
Bruk sets one plain plate at the end.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Everyone receives a fair slice if the hand is steady.

choices.label: Brace the Banquet Gate
choices.playerLine: The pantry opens only if the gate holds.
choices.narration: Bruk braces the gate and weakens the royal block pattern.

choices.label: Set a Place for the King
choices.playerLine: The first plate is yours, if you can share the second.
choices.narration: Bruk pulls out a chair and the palace's table grows long enough for a king and guests.

choices.label: Declare the Grand Snack Charge
choices.playerLine: The pantry opens, the table marches, and every locked cake rides with us!
choices.narration: Bruk charges down the royal hall with a banquet table like a shield-wall.

postChoiceBarks.text: A table is measured by welcome.

victoryCallback.text: The gate is open. The table is set.

bossCallback.text: Supper tastes better when no one must climb a throne to reach it.
